correctness.rationale: Four labelled report copies on R/Z with geodesic distance admit a globally optimal report because the piecewise-linear total-distance function only jumps upward at reports. The optimality slope inequalities and reflection yield normalized (-a,0,b,c), 0<=a<=1/2, 0<=b<=c<=1/2 with OPT=a+b+c. For four-agent EPCD, probability of clockwise report zi is (g_{i+1}+g_{i+2})/2; expressing full social costs and splitting according to a+c<=1/2, a+b<=1/2<=a+c, or a+b>=1/2 yields three exact algebraic identities for F=5OPT-4C_E, each nonnegative, and equality only at (-1/4,0,0,1/4) for OPT>0. RD triangle inequality gives <=3OPT/2 and same witness attains both bounds, so every fixed mixture has exact sharp ratio (5+lambda)/4 for lambda in [0,1], including EPCD 5/4 and equal mixture 11/8. Independent rational input checks verified the direct random-deletion EPCD formula and all three case identities; they are corroboration, not proof over continuum.
